title: Add staging to your Google sign-in client (1 min)

owner_note.text: Google Cloud Console → APIs & Services → Credentials → OAuth client 722949407087-g0kag… → Authorized JavaScript origins → add https://staging.lew42.com → Save. Until then real Google sign-in on the /join/ demo is refused; the mock path still works.
